content: pytest layout guidance: tests outside application code in top-level tests/ is recommended for functional tests; tests can run against installed or editable package. importlib import mode recommended for new projects (addopts --import-mode=importlib) — sys.path not modified. tmp_path fixture for tests writing files; conftest.py for shared fixtures. For script-style repos (not an installable package), PYTHONPATH or pythonpath config pointing at script dir lets tests import script modules.
